diff.openWorkingFileHint.en: Open the current working tree file for editing; its contents may differ from this historical comparison.

diff.previousChangeAcrossCommitFilesWrap.en: Previous change across Commit files (press again at the first to go to the last)
diff.previousChangeAcrossCommitFilesWrap.zh-CN: 上一处修改（跨 Commit 文件；在首处再次执行将跳转到末处）

diff.previousChangeWrapsToTheLast.en: Previous change (press again at the first to go to the last)
diff.previousChangeWrapsToTheLast.zh-CN: 上一处修改（在首处再次执行将跳转到末处）

diff.nextChangeAcrossCommitFilesWrapsToT.en: Next change across Commit files (press again at the last to go to the first)
diff.nextChangeAcrossCommitFilesWrapsToT.zh-CN: 下一处修改（跨 Commit 文件；在末处再次执行将跳转到首处）

diff.nextChangeWrapsToTheFirst.en: Next change (press again at the last to go to the first)
diff.nextChangeWrapsToTheFirst.zh-CN: 下一处修改（在末处再次执行将跳转到首处）

diff.fileFirstChangeReached.en: This is the first change in the current file. Run Previous change again to go to the last change.
diff.fileFirstChangeReached.zh-CN: 已到当前文件第一处修改；再次执行“上一处修改”将跳转到最后一处。

diff.fileLastChangeReached.en: This is the last change in the current file. Run Next change again to go to the first change.
diff.fileLastChangeReached.zh-CN: 已到当前文件最后一处修改；再次执行“下一处修改”将跳转到第一处。

diff.commitFirstChangeReached.en: This is the first change in the current Commit. Run Previous change again to go to the last change in this Commit.
diff.commitFirstChangeReached.zh-CN: 已到当前 Commit 第一处修改；再次执行“上一处修改”将跳转到本 Commit 最后一处。

diff.commitLastChangeReached.en: This is the last change in the current Commit. Run Next change again to go to the first change in this Commit.
diff.commitLastChangeReached.zh-CN: 已到当前 Commit 最后一处修改；再次执行“下一处修改”将跳转到本 Commit 第一处。
